versions.subject: Create proc_creation_win_lolbin_forfiles.yml
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: \forfiles.exe
    - OriginalFileName: forfiles.exe
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        # The CLI accepts combination of both "slash" and "dash"
        - ' /p '
        - ' /m '
        - ' /c '
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: Image="*\\forfiles.exe" OR OriginalFileName="forfiles.exe" CommandLine="* /p *" CommandLine="* /m *" CommandLine="* /c *"

versions.subject: Update proc_creation_win_lolbin_forfiles.yml
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: \forfiles.exe
    - OriginalFileName: forfiles.exe
selection_cli_p:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /p '
        - ' -p '
selection_cli_m:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /m '
        - ' -m '
selection_cli_c:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /c '
        - ' -c '
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: Image="*\\forfiles.exe" OR OriginalFileName="forfiles.exe" CommandLine IN ("* /p *", "* -p *") CommandLine IN ("* /m *", "* -m *") CommandLine IN ("* /c *", "* -c *")
